name: Flutter & Dart Mobile Toolkit
author: Mintu Community
description: Stateful/Stateless widgets, Riverpod providers, Dio HTTP clients, leak-safe lifecycle rules, and one-click Flutter build/test commands.
ai_rules: When writing Flutter widgets, separate presentation from business logic; keep build() methods pure and extract sub-trees into const widgets.
Always dispose controllers (TextEditingController, AnimationController, ScrollController) in dispose() to prevent memory leaks.
Use LayoutBuilder or MediaQuery for responsive adaptive layouts across mobile, tablet, and desktop form factors.
